name: Pappu Charu
steps: Rinse dal and pressure-cook with turmeric and 600 ml water for 3–4 whistles until soft; mash well.
Simmer chopped tomatoes, onion, green chillies and chilli powder in 300 ml water for 8 minutes. Add tamarind pulp, jaggery and salt.
Add mashed dal and remaining 200 ml water. Simmer 10 minutes until the broth is pourable but still tastes of dal.
Crackle mustard and cumin in oil, add dried chillies and curry leaves, then pour the tempering over the charu. Serve hot with rice.
tips: Pappu charu is thinner than ordinary dal but fuller-bodied than rasam.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
